agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: The clone ended in a verified whiteout; the Bushtank/Bugatti bundle is not viable for another unchanged retry.

resolution.observed: The losing Bushtank/Bugatti roster was retired. The restored six matches the roster of prior verified Gavi clone wins and starts from a new exact checkpoint; qualification restarts at Clone 1.

findings.observed_fact: Dustox remained at full 52 HP when Croakatoa, the final party member, fainted.

findings.summary: Full-health Ohmnomnom still failed to convert Eelektrik because Super Fang, Sitrus Berry, and resisted damage left Eelektrik at 33 HP.

resolution.observed: Preparation replaced Bugatti with Coppertop and restored the previously winning Ohmnomnom/Croakatoa/Bushtank/Lildozer/Coppertop/Birdlaw roster. The failed single-counter assignment will not be retried.

findings.observed_fact: Ohmnomnom entered at 50 HP, dealt Spark, Nuzzle, and two Metal Claws, then fainted; Eelektrik healed through its Sitrus threshold.

findings.summary: The profile preferred fresh-entry Fake Out on Eelektrik, but the reusable strategy vetoed that exact action and forced Spark instead.

resolution.observed: Exact turn-011 replay now selects fresh Fake Out with fresh_entry_flinch evidence and no strategy veto.

findings.observed_fact: Fake Out had fresh-entry evidence and profile preference, but forbidden_by contained strategy:status-immune-converter-preserved-finisher.

findings.summary: After Ohmnomnom fainted, the forced selector spent Birdlaw and then Bugatti into Eelektrik, recreating the same reserved-finisher death relay.

resolution.observed: Exact turn-015 replay now selects Croakatoa as a progress-capable replacement and ranks Birdlaw below it because Birdlaw covers two later opponents.

findings.observed_fact: Birdlaw was poisoned and fainted after two Quick Attacks; Bugatti then needed two Bug Bites and reached Dustox at 17 HP.

findings.summary: At fresh Dustox, the forced selector chose 9-HP slower Bushtank, which fainted before acting, instead of valuing a replacement able to use priority before defeat.

resolution.observed: Exact turn-022 replay now selects Croakatoa with progress_before_faint=true; 9-HP Bushtank remains progress_before_faint=false and is not selected.

findings.observed_fact: Bushtank's Bite was interrupted before execution; Croakatoa was the only alternative and had priority Vacuum Wave, which the mechanics table did not classify as priority.

findings.summary: Fresh Croakatoa used Fake Out on Dustox, but Dustox still used Venoshock; the flinch assumption is invalid for this opponent.

resolution.observed: Exact turn-025 replay reads Dustox ability 19, removes fresh-entry flinch safety from Fake Out, and selects Mud Shot instead. The Shield Dust regression passes.

findings.observed_fact: Fake Out PP decreased and Dustox immediately executed Venoshock, consistent with its flinch-blocking ability.

findings.summary: Seven switches occurred; four were forced replacements caused by depleted matchup answers, not productive strategy pivots.
findings.observed_fact: The Eelektrik and Dustox phases repeatedly selected the least-immediate-death target instead of preserving roles or guaranteeing progress.

correct_choices: Bushtank removed Bibarel with two Razor Leafs.
The corrected Ponyta branch preserved Ohmnomnom: Lildozer fainted, Croakatoa used fresh Fake Out and Mud Shot, then Ohmnomnom entered Eelektrik at full HP.
No observation, PP, or input acknowledgement mismatch occurred in 26 verified actions.
The anti-switch-stall rules prevented voluntary no-action reversals; the remaining defect is forced replacement and preparation quality.
agent_review.next_test: Do not retry this bundle. Correct the fresh Fake Out conflict, teach the mechanics table Vacuum Wave priority, rank progress-capable forced replacements ahead of zero-action sacks, and prepare a stronger Electric-resistant Eelektrik counter before restarting Clone 1.
